{{Top|leg}}
A '''flight pack''' allowed a user to fly using a combination of fuel, [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], and wings. They were used by the [[ExGal-4]] scientists [[Bendodi Ballow-Reese]], [[Jerem Cadmir]], [[Luther De'Ono]], and [[Tee-ubo Doole]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] on [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] to help them travel while investigating the storm created by [[Yomin Carr]]'s [[dweebit]]s.
